blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte on Wednesday hit back at private prosecutor Lorna Kapunan for calling her lead defense counsel, Sheila Sison, a “bully,” describing the remark as a “convenient way to vilify the person defending against an overwhelming display of political power.” Kapunan made the remark after Sison delivered heated manifestations against the prosecution following its withdrawal of three of the four articles of impeachment against Duterte. READ: ‘Duterte impeachment articles dropped as defense seeks to stretch trial’ “Lorna Kapunan calling a defense counsel a bully is like calling David the aggressor against Goliath,” Duterte said in a […]...
